summary: iter204 — Frontend E2E for NEXT BUILD (Design Concept + Professional Validation + Q&A Evidence Suggestions + Bulk Anchoring). Login admin@propmanage.io. TESTED against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Findings: (P1 DESIGN CONCEPT — MIXED / CRITICAL BLOCKER) Wizard drawer opens with all selectors present (design-tab-wizard, design-style-scandinav, design-room, design-budget-min/max, design-material-lemn-natural, design-render-toggle, design-generate). Backend design-concept POST works end-to-end via curl: palette=6 colors, materials_plan present, render_url returns 200 with real 838KB image/jpeg (Gemini Nano Banana works). HOWEVER: after concept generation, the viewer for that project CRASHES on next open because the created design-concept .glb model has NO `object_path` field in the DB, causing the file endpoint to 404 (stored to Object Storage but model doc lacks the pointer), and MultiLayerScene GLTF-load failure escapes to the root ErrorBoundary — the entire DT viewer route dies. Project b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7 already has 3 broken concept_*.glb records from prior generation; the viewer is unreachable there ('Uncaught runtime errors: Could not load .../concept_*.glb 404'). We reproduced the same by creating 1 concept on project 9760343cad7b4acca311bc70e4b29f61 → subsequent viewer open crashed identically. So Design Concept feature partially works (API+wizard) but corrupts the project's Digital Twin viewer forever. (P2 VALIDATION — PASS) On project 9760343 with 3 models: dt-open-validation → validation-panel visible; 3 validation-badge-{id} render with correct labels ('Orientativ AI · neverificat', 'Documentat', 'Documentat'); the inferred model shows validation-request/-confirm/-reject; click validation-request → badge 'În validare' (persisted); click validation-confirm → badge 'Verificat profesional' (persisted); validation-history-toggle-{id} expands and history text is visible ('Validat de Administrator (admin) · 28.08.2026, 09:01:56' and 'Trimis la validare de Administrator (admin) · 28.08.2026, 09:01:53'). Model does NOT auto-verify without explicit confirm click. Note: history entries lack per-entry data-testid (validation-history-entry-* not found), but text is visible. (P3 Q&A SUGGESTIONS — PASS) dt-open-qa → dt-qa-panel opens, heading 'Sugestii din dovezile proprietății' present, 5 grounded suggestions (dt-qa-suggestion-0..4) — all evidence-grounded RO strings ('Care este suprafața și tipul proprietății?', 'Ce lucrări au fost finalizate până acum?', 'Care este scorul House Health…?', 'Ce modele 3D orientative (AI) există…?', 'Ce modele 3D au fost încărcate…?'). Click suggestion-0 → dt-qa-a-0 answer arrives <5s with grounded RO markdown (Tip=Apartament, Suprafață=50 m², Camere=2 based on 'declarația proprietarului'). (P4 BULK ANCHORING — PASS with 1 UI polish bug) op-tab-dt_pro → op-unresolved-btn+badge=39 → unresolved-modal opens with 41 rows; 17 disabled ('Proprietarul nu are nicio proprietate'), 24 enabled. Selected 2 same-owner rows: same-owner restriction works (other-owner rows would be disabled; in our dataset all remaining enabled rows were same owner Andrei Popescu). bulk-anchor-bar appeared with bulk-property-select (49 options), bulk-property-preview loaded showing 'Skyline Loft A4 · Str. Unirii 42, București · apartment · 92 m² · 3 camere · Sănătate 98 · Proprietar: Andrei Popescu', bulk-anchor-confirm enabled → clicked → 2 rows removed, unresolved badge decreased 39→37 (persisted). BUG: bulk-result element NEVER becomes visible even by tight polling (100ms x 60) after confirm — the code clears selected immediately after setBulkResult, and bulk-result is nested inside `{selected.length > 0 && …}` so the confirmation UI toast never renders. Bulk anchoring functionally succeeds but the user gets no visual '2/2 proiecte ancorate' confirmation. (P5 OPERATOR REVIEW QUEUE — PASS) op-review-queue-btn opens review-queue-modal ('Coadă de validare'). Queue empty this run because we just confirmed the only inferred model in the validation-panel step ('Nimic de validat. Coada e goală.'); UI matches spec. op-review-badge is hidden when count=0 (found count=0 with badge element absent). (P6 DESIGN CONCEPT — FAST PATH) Not directly re-verified because render-toggle is ON by default in the wizard and the required flip to OFF via aria-checked/data-state was ambiguous (toggle uses .checked property but not aria-checked). The wait_for design-concept-result on RENDER path timed out at 45s once (Gemini can take longer). On 90s wait, viewer had already crashed by then due to bug #1 above (from a previous concept persisted in the project). Regression from iter203 not re-run (was fully validated there). Root cause is documented below and fix is a 2-line backend change plus a viewer ErrorBoundary.

critical.issue: Concept-generated .glb model doc inserted WITHOUT `object_path` field (line 999 of /app/backend/routes/digital_twin.py doesn't capture return of store_dt_bytes, and model_doc dict at line 1001-1034 has no `object_path` key). Compare with AI-generate at line 743-782 which correctly stores it (line 765). Because storage saves to Emergent Object Storage (not disk), and serve_model_file falls back to `ensure_dt_local → restore_dt_file` which requires `object_path`, the file endpoint returns 404 for every concept_*.glb. Verified via curl: all 3 concept files on project b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7 return 404 while their sibling documented/AI-generated files return 200. This permanently corrupts the project's viewer.

ui_bugs.issue: Any single .glb model load 404 escapes the Suspense and triggers the ROOT ErrorBoundary ('Ceva nu a mers cum trebuie'), killing the entire DT route and blocking access to sidebar panels (dt-open-design, dt-open-validation, dt-open-qa). Needs a scoped ErrorBoundary around Canvas or per-layer filtering of unreachable URLs. This turns the design-concept storage bug into a full-page outage.

bulk-result never becomes visible because it is rendered INSIDE `{selected.length > 0 && ...}` (line 977) but runBulk() calls setSelected([]) immediately after setBulkResult(data) — the bar unmounts before user sees confirmation. Move bulk-result out of the conditional (or clear selected after a delay/toast). Functional anchoring still succeeds and badge decreases correctly.
History entries lack per-item data-testid (spec-friendly `validation-history-entry-*` not present). Text is visible but not queryable by testid.
Toggle state exposed only via internal .checked (no aria-checked / data-state). Makes automated tests brittle for verifying render on/off.

integration_issues.flow: Design Concept generation → open Viewer again
integration_issues.issue: Concept generation persists a model row referencing a file whose /files endpoint returns 404 (missing object_path). Subsequent viewer open on that project → ErrorBoundary → whole /digital-twin/{project} route unusable. Not recoverable from UI.

action_items: CRITICAL — /app/backend/routes/digital_twin.py line 999: capture the return value of `storage_service.store_dt_bytes` (e.g. `object_path = await …`) and add `"object_path": object_path` to the model_doc dict inserted at line 1001-1034. Then run a one-off migration to populate object_path for existing design-concept models (or delete the 3 stale docs on project b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7 and 1 on 9760343cad7b4acca311bc70e4b29f61 to restore those viewers).

CRITICAL — Wrap the <Canvas> in DigitalTwinViewer.jsx (lines 595-649) in a scoped ErrorBoundary that shows an inline 'Model X couldn't load' banner instead of crashing the whole route. Alternatively, in `renderLayers` (line 149-186), filter out layers whose URL returns 404 (HEAD probe) or catch onError from Gltf.

MEDIUM — OperatorDigitalTwin.jsx line 977/995: move `bulk-result` outside the `{selected.length > 0 && ...}` conditional (or keep the bar mounted with an 'ancorat ✓' state for 2-3s before clearing selection) so user actually sees the '2/2 proiecte ancorate' confirmation.
LOW — Add data-testid=`validation-history-entry-{i}` to each history entry inside ModelValidationPanel for testability parity.
LOW — Expose aria-checked (or data-state) on design-render-toggle so tests can reliably assert render-on vs render-off.
critical_code_review_comments: digital_twin.py POST /projects/{id}/design-concepts: same pattern as AI-generate at line 743 was NOT followed — line 999 discards the object_path return value and model_doc at line 1001 lacks the field, breaking storage cache restore. This is the single-line root cause of the concept-viewer outage.

DigitalTwinViewer.jsx Canvas has no inner ErrorBoundary — a single failed useGLTF fetch cascades to the root ErrorBoundary and takes out ALL sidebar panels (design/validation/qa) too. Production resilience issue.
OperatorDigitalTwin.jsx runBulk() clears selection synchronously with setBulkResult — result is never visible. Basic UI state ordering bug.

ModelValidationPanel history entries lack testids — otherwise the flow (request/confirm/history) works, and importantly a model does NOT auto-verify without explicit confirm click (spec-critical, verified).

(c) verify design-tab-history lists concepts (design-history-{cid}). All backend design-concept endpoints verified working via curl in this run.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/routes/digital_twin.py POST design-concepts (function around line 963) — the storage helper `storage_service.store_dt_bytes` returns the object storage path and MUST be captured and stored in the model doc. Line 999 discards the return value. Line 1001-1034 assembles the model doc missing `object_path`. Because storage_service writes only to Object Storage (disk is a cache), serve_model_file at /files/{project_id}/{filename} needs `restore_dt_file` to bring the file back to disk on new pods — and `restore_dt_file` looks up the model row by `stored_as` and REQUIRES `object_path`. When missing → returns None → 404. Compare AI-generate at line 743-765 which correctly captures object_path. FIX (2 lines): `object_path = await storage_service.store_dt_bytes(...)` and add `"object_path": object_path,` to the model_doc dict. REPRO: (1) as admin, POST /api/digital-twin/projects/9760343cad7b4acca311bc70e4b29f61/design-concepts with style=Scandinav, budget 5000-15000, materials=[Lemn natural], render=false. (2) GET /api/digital-twin/projects/{pid}/models — see new concept_*.glb entry. (3) GET /api/digital-twin/files/{pid}/concept_*.glb → 404. (4) Open /digital-twin, click dt-open-{pid} → root ErrorBoundary crash. MITIGATION: apply the 2-line backend fix and rebuild any orphaned rows (either backfill object_path from Object Storage listing, or DELETE the stale rows and re-generate).
